title: The Crazy Paisley Pattern Maker
author: SofydollDesigns
description:
Welcome to The Crazy Paisley Pattern Maker…a fun-filled brush pack that includes everything you need to create vibrant paisley patterns. Simply select a paisley stamp, fill it with color and add a border and embellishments and off you go! Create a bunch, add some extra elements and now you’ve got a complete paisley style background.
Included in this set:
• 38 Paisley Maker Brushes
• 1 Canvas Texture
